title: party prompts follow the last input device
why: His order (2026-10-18): "player should get key prompts if that is the last input they used -- xbox controller prompts should only pop up if player is actively using the controller -- e.g. real time glyph switching -- fortnite does a great job with this". v30.66 routed the raid, hub and menu prompts. These still named both devices at once or one fixed device: the arcade attract and the idle callouts said press any button, the easy mode question said Y or A and N or B, the initials hint said type or arrows, A next, B back, Enter / Menu done, and the trade offer said T or Y. Each now asks the one reader (padOn) and shows the keys or the buttons of the last device used; the open initials card follows in place.
now: Party prompts now show keys or buttons by what you used last: press any key or button, yes or no, the initials hint and the trade offer.
